notes.title: Omnn Demo 1.1
notes.content:
Welcome! I hope you've all enjoyed OMNN. I am releasing a small update/patch fixing a few things with the demo.

Here are the fixes:

-Fixed visual bugs with geometry in a couple of scenes 

-Fixed weird reflection alignment in intro. 

-Increased time in which intro text displays upon new game.

-Fixed visual bug in the helicopter scene with some of the UI.

-Added ability to skip intro logos.
